text: A documentary crew follows four vampire housemates through their nights in a Wellington flat: the dandy Viago, the old tyrant Vladislav, the rebel Deacon and the ancient, feral Petyr. They take the bus into town to [hunt the streets for blood|wants|feeding on the living], and keep [a human servant, Jackie, who cleans up the gore|who_suffers|people at work] and longs to be made immortal. When a guest named Nick is [chased through the flat and turned|origin|caught from another], the household gains a member who cannot keep secrets, and a sunlit basement becomes [a fatal mistake|rules|it has a fatal weakness].
